title: Cargo Train Puzzle
description: Switch railway junctions, lay smooth curved tracks, and guide cheerful steam locomotives safely to their matching station platforms.
controls: Tap track switches or tiles to route each locomotive cleanly into its color-matched station.

zh-CN.title: 小火车货运
zh-CN.description: 温馨益智轨道规划小火车货运：拨动道岔连接铁路轨道，护送满载货物的小火车平稳驶入终点车站！
zh-CN.controls: 点击调整轨道方向与道岔，顺利引导货运小火车避开碰撞安全抵达车站。
